infrastructure._release: 4.0.0 (MAJOR): removes the permission-change-helper; every permission change goes through the core permission-changes procedure. Before publishing, every installed collection must be at its permission-changes release (upgrade/3-to-4.md). 3.x is supported until 2027-01-31.
infrastructure.name: agent-index-core
infrastructure.description: The foundational collection: session bootstrap, member management, org configuration, capability authoring, update orchestration, and the canonical CLAUDE.md template. Required for every agent-index install.
infrastructure.author: agent-index

infrastructure._release: 2.22.1: upgrade-collection writes update-log entries with operations[] (members receive same-version collection changes); install-collection refuses collections that still use the removed permission helper and never resets seed data on Reconfigure. 2.22.0: install-collection provisions collection access through the core permission-changes procedure (admin confirms the exact changes, no helper binary) and accepts the legacy grants[] key; requires core 3.32.0.
infrastructure.name: agent-index-marketplace
infrastructure.description: The marketplace integration collection: discover, download, and install marketplace collections; check for updates across all installed pieces; refresh the marketplace cache.
infrastructure.author: agent-index
